name: Kanojo no Kimochi
source:
Main character is a high school student who is good at basketball and who has a girlfriend. But as graduation approaches he gets fatigued of his girlfriend. Older memories call him and he is going to pay a visit to his other acquaintances. 

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-august-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角是一名擅长篮球并有女朋友的高中生。但随着毕业的临近，他对女友感到厌倦。较早的记忆呼唤着他，他要去拜访其他熟人。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-august-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
